system.description:
This Nindo is one of power. When you lose a clash with a hostile creature, you can choose to spend 2 Drive. When you do, you treat this clash as if it were a draw.

Additionally, when you roll initiative fighting a hostile creature whose level is 2 or higher than your own, you gain 2 Will of Fire. If you have not used these Will of Fire before the end of combat, you lose them.
